text:
frank: Quick flag 1 — after enabling q8b-int4 on longprompt-bank the long-summary promptset shows weird "bleedthrough": model repeats earlier anchors and recall drops ~15%. failing ids: s3://redwood-curation/longprompt/v2/fails-6955554321.txt :thinking:

anya: Bleedthrough how? repeating prefix tokens or entire earlier anchor?

frank: Mostly repeating prefix fragments (first ~12 tokens) and sometimes full anchor echoes mid-output. Added metric `prefix_echo_frac_first12` = 0.27 vs baseline 0.03.

marta: Could be KV cache aliasing with quant packing. Before runtime, let's rule out dataset issues: any manifest transforms?

frank: Ingest unchanged. Ran a quick tokenwalk dedupe at 0.85 and it removes ~6.5% anchors. Command: 
```
tokenwalk dedupe --input s3://redwood-curation/longprompt/v2/manifest.json \
  --out s3://redwood-curation/longprompt/v2/dedup-0.85.json --threshold 0.85 --keep-anchors 6000
```

devin: Can you run eval with `--kv-debug` and an fp16 fallback? I'll compare traces.

frank: Kicked off: 
```
./eval_run --model long-cand:q8b-int4 --prompts s3://redwood-curation/longprompt/v2/manifest.json \
  --kv-debug --fallback fp16 --out ./runs/long-q8b-int4-debug-6955554321.json
```

labelops_bot: Label queue created: queue_id=lab-q-2026-03-31-08, size=642, sampler=longprompt-dedupe-0.85, priority=high

marta: We can do 520 judgements/day if we trim context to anchor + 1-line summary. I'll shard to 3 and tag ambiguous as `needs-panel`. ETA first shard EOD PST.

devin: FP16 fallback finished  fp16 restores recall within 2% baseline. Traces uploaded: s3://redwood-runs/longprompt/q8b-int4-fp16-debug-6955554321.json. Int4 traces show identical KV slots reused across unrelated anchors.

irin: Runtime theory: quant packing for q8b is using grouped-KV compression that occasionally hashes different tokens to same compressed code when prefix aligners trigger. We added a canary flag last sprint `--kv-unique-hash` that enforces per-token hash salt. Might try canary.

anya: Parallel path please: (1) runtime try canary with `--kv-unique-hash`; (2) marta push labeler shards on dedup-reduced manifest; (3) frank prototype 250 synthetic longprompts that insert small separators (token noise) to break accidental alignment and add 150 to golden review.

frank: Will generate synthetics: 
```
python tools/synth_long_noise.py --src s3://redwood-curation/longprompt/v2/golden.json \
  --out s3://redwood-curation/longprompt/v2/synthetics/noise-250.json --n 250 --ops insert_sep,swap
```

labelops_bot: Queue update: shard1=214 assigned, shard2=214 queued, shard3=214 queued. Progress URL: https://labels.redwood/queues/lab-q-2026-03-31-08

marta: Shard1 started. Instruction: preserve canonical anchor if present, mark `needs-panel` for 1) semantic merges, 2) long-context paraphrases where labeler unsure.

devin: Ran int4 canary with `--kv-unique-hash` now. Canary run looks promising  echo metric drops to 0.04 and matches fp16. Upload: s3://redwood-runs/longprompt/q8b-int4-canary-6955554321.json

irin: If canary aligns with fp16, we'll file RUNTIME-1160 to include the salt by default. That should solve aliasing without needing to expand golden, but we'll still add synthetics as a hedge.

frank: Blocking auto-rollout of q8b-int4 profile for longprompt-bank until either canary merged or lab relabel + regen complete.

marta: First shard 190/214 done, ~24 left. I'll post daily progress. :thumbsup:

anya: Good work. Action recap in case we lose thread: 1) @irin runtime canary `--kv-unique-hash` (done)  @irin follow RUNTIME-1160, 2) @marta finish label shards and golden review, 3) @frank push synthetics and run dedupe scripts. Recheck regression after either kernel patch or relabel + augment.
